department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Applications by 12/15/2026 get guaranteed review; later ones are reviewed as space and funding allow until 03/15/2027.
deadline.quote: These are the application deadlines for applicants who wish to begin their graduate studies in fall 2027. | Civil and Environmental Engineering 12/15/2026

funding.value: Department lists a five-year stipend package.
funding.quote: 5 years of stipend—plus six years of health and dental coverage

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's degree (US or equivalent); a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold either a US bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a regionally accredited institution.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
